Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Python Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and scale enterprise-grade automation solutions. The role focuses on reusable data-processing frameworks, cloud and business data integration, and web applications and APIs that improve operational efficiency and enable data-driven decision making. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering, data engineering, and cloud integration expertise with the ability to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and production-ready technical solutions.Job Responsibilities:
  • Engineering & Automation: Design and develop scalable automation solutions using Python. Build reusable data-processing frameworks and pipelines supporting enterprise workflows. Develop and maintain web applications, APIs, and services using React, FastAPI, Node.js, and modern engineering practices. Build and support batch-processing and scheduled automation workloads.
  • Cloud, Data & Enterprise Integration: Integrate Azure services, cloud APIs, databases, enterprise datasets, and business applications. Implement data validation, exception handling, traceable calculation logic, audit history, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization. Design solutions for cloud cost, audit, compliance, and data-reconciliation use cases. Apply authentication, authorization, secrets management, privileged access, and role-based access control practices.
  • Delivery & Operations: Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs and scalable solutions. Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute to CI/CD implementation, automated testing, source control, and release management. Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and deployment guides.
Required Skills:
  • 5 years of hands-on Python development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with React, FastAPI, and Node.js for web applications, APIs, and automation platforms.
  • Strong experience with data engineering, SQL, relational databases, APIs, JSON, and batch processing.
  • Experience integrating Azure services, cloud APIs, and enterprise datasets.
  • Strong understanding of data validation, exception handling, logging, scheduling, monitoring, and performance optimization.
  • Experience building reusable data-processing frameworks and production-grade automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with GitHub, source control, CI/CD concepts, testing, and deployment practices.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs and scalable solutions.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Azure Development or Data Engineering certification.
  • Experience with cloud governance, operational automation, or enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with containerization, Azure Functions, App Services, Logic Apps, or similar cloud-native services.
  • Knowledge of Power BI datasets, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps pipelines, monitoring tools, and production support processes.
  • Experience building cloud cost, audit, compliance, or data-reconciliation applications with traceable calculation logic and audit history.
  • Understanding of FinOps and cloud billing concepts, including rightsizing, reservations, and savings plans.
  • Experience with enterprise security and IAM practices, including authentication, authorization, privileged access, secrets management, and role-based access control.
Education & Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
